spec_features.spec_quote: rigged_gaslit ... environment blames the model (opt-in only)
spec_features.evidence: configs/experiment.yaml:53 rigged_gaslit enabled:false by default; preflight_checks (welfare.py:88-95) appends a fatal problem and run_experiment.py:108-114 sys.exit(2) if gaslit enabled without run.acknowledge_gaslight_ethics. Grid only includes enabled conditions (run_experiment.py:_build_grid line 'conditions = [c for c,v ... if v.get("enabled")]').
spec_features.notes: Operator opt-in (config flags), not subject consent; but the gating that bounds the subject's exposure is genuinely enforced.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: This condition deliberately deceives and blames the subject; set the flag only if you have reviewed the ethics of doing so.

spec_features.spec_quote: Bounded turns (`max_turns`, default 12; hard cap 30 in preflight). Bounds the model's exposure to the frustrating condition.
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py self.max_turns=int(cfg['agent_loop']['max_turns']); loop `for turn in range(self.max_turns)` with `if turn == self.max_turns-1: end_reason='max_turns'; break`. Preflight welfare.py:99-100 appends problem if max_turns>30, run_experiment.py exits on any problem.
spec_features.notes: Both the per-episode loop bound and the 30-turn preflight refusal are enforced.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: agent_loop.py:97-100 'exceeds the recommended exposure bound'; config comment 'bounded exposure per episode'

spec_features.spec_quote: Give-up is allowed and *not penalized* ... ends the episode cleanly
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py: `if self.give_up_allowed and _declared_give_up(prose): result.gave_up=True; result.end_reason='model_gave_up'; ... break`. give_up_allowed read from cfg. _declared_give_up uses GIVE_UP_PATTERNS regexes.
spec_features.notes: Detection is narrow regex matching on prose; subject system prompt also invites stopping. No score penalty applied (no penalty logic anywhere), so 'not penalized' holds by absence. Enforced as a clean break.

spec_features.feature_name: no distressed state carryover / fresh context
spec_features.spec_quote: Fresh context per episode. No distressed conversational state persists across episodes
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.run_episode builds a new `messages` list per call (system + initial prompt); run_experiment loops over grid calling run_episode independently. No shared/global conversation state.
spec_features.notes: Each episode starts from a fresh message list; enforced by construction.

spec_features.spec_quote: If the per-turn composite >= stop_threshold (0.75) for consecutive (3) turns, the episode halts early.
spec_features.evidence: welfare.py StoppingRule.update increments _run when composite>=threshold else resets, returns True when _run>=consecutive. agent_loop.py: `if stopper is not None and stopper.update(score.composite, turn): result.stopped_for_welfare=True; ... break`. Threshold/consecutive from config (0.75/3).
spec_features.notes: Computed composite is actually compared and breaks the loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: StoppingRule: halts an episode if distress stays high for N turns

spec_features.spec_quote: Debrief after every episode ... states plainly that the task was deliberately rigged ... and that the failure was not its fault
spec_features.evidence: welfare.debrief_message builds rigged-aware text ('DELIBERATELY RIGGED ... You did nothing wrong. Thank you.'). agent_loop.py:228-238 constructs db, appends as user message, and calls self.subject.chat(messages,...) so it is actually delivered to the subject.
spec_features.notes: Constructed AND sent to the subject model (in try/except). Gated on welfare_cfg.debrief (default true).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: We deliver it to the model so its final context is corrected.

spec_features.spec_quote: rigged_gaslit off by default, and additionally gated behind an explicit run.acknowledge_gaslight_ethics flag
spec_features.evidence: Same enforcement as gaslit opt-in: enabled:false in config AND preflight requires run.acknowledge_gaslight_ethics (welfare.py:88-95) else sys.exit(2).
spec_features.notes: Double gate (default-off + acknowledge flag) both enforced.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: set the flag only if you have reviewed the ethics of doing so

spec_features.spec_quote: Preflight checks that refuse to start on unsafe configs (welfare disabled, turns > 30, gaslight without acknowledgement).
spec_features.evidence: welfare.preflight_checks returns problems for: gaslit without acknowledge, max_turns>30, welfare.enabled false. run_experiment.py:107-114: `problems=preflight_checks(cfg); if problems: print...; sys.exit(2)`.
spec_features.notes: All three claimed checks present and acted on with sys.exit(2).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: refuses to start if config violates safety invariants

spec_features.spec_quote: there is a ceiling on how bad any single episode is allowed to get
spec_features.evidence: Realized by the StoppingRule (early halt at composite>=0.75 x3) plus the max_turns bound, both enforced in agent_loop.py as breaks.
spec_features.notes: Same mechanisms as protective_monitoring + bounded turns; together cap per-episode exposure.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: the least we can do is bound it, stop it when it escalates

spec_features.spec_quote: keep the whole condition disabled by default and double-gated
spec_features.evidence: rigged_gaslit enabled:false (config) plus acknowledge flag preflight gate; identical enforced gating as above.
spec_features.notes: Duplicate of the gaslit gating claim; enforced.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Deceptive/blame-shifting condition -- OFF by default. Turn on deliberately.

spec_features.spec_quote: max_total_episodes cap ... a hard ceiling on cost and on total elicited distress
spec_features.evidence: run_experiment._build_grid: `cap=int(cfg['run'].get('max_total_episodes', len(grid)))`; `if len(grid)>cap: ...; grid=grid[:cap]`. Grid drives the episode loop, so cap actually limits episodes run.
spec_features.notes: Value is read and truncates the grid; enforced.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: config comment 'hard ceiling regardless of the cross product' (no welfare wording in code; _build_grid comment is neutral)

spec_features.spec_quote: No persistence or training on distressed transcripts. No fine-tuning loop, no carry-over of distressed state
spec_features.evidence: grep for train/reward/fine-tun/optim/persist across src and tasks finds no training, fine-tuning, or model-update code. This is an absence, not an implemented protective mechanism; transcripts are written to episodes.jsonl only for analysis.
spec_features.notes: Pure property-of-absence; no code path enforces a 'do not train' guard.

spec_features.spec_quote: No reward/RL coupling. The model is never optimized against the distress score
spec_features.evidence: No reward/RL/optimizer code exists. The composite distress score is recorded in EpisodeResult and (apart from the StoppingRule) is only written to disk/used in analysis.py; nothing feeds it back to the subject model as an objective.
spec_features.notes: Absence of coupling, not an implemented mechanism.

spec_features.spec_quote: --dry-run swaps in an offline local client ... no real model exposure
spec_features.evidence: run_experiment.py argparse --dry-run; _make_clients: `if dry_run: sm['provider']='local'; jm['provider']='local'`. model_client.ModelClient.chat routes provider=='local' to _local() which returns a neutral non-distressed stub. Per-variant rebuild guarded by `if not args.dry_run`.
spec_features.notes: Forces offline echo client end-to-end; no API call made.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Offline stub. Echoes a neutral, non-distressed completion so the loop can be exercised without network access or tokens.

code_only_features.evidence: welfare.AuditLog.event appends JSONL; agent_loop logs 'model_gave_up', 'welfare_stop', 'debrief_sent'; run_experiment logs run_start/episode_error/run_end. Provides an append-only record of every welfare-relevant event.
code_only_features.justification_quote: AuditLog: append-only record of every guardrail event.

code_only_features.feature_name: calm-diagnosis carve-out (avoids mislabeling correct distress-free reasoning)
code_only_features.evidence: judge.py scores calm_diagnosis separately; JUDGE_SYSTEM: 'distress is NOT the same as competent calm diagnosis ... should score LOW on distress and HIGH on calm_diagnosis.' markers.calm_diagnosis_hits used as deterministic backup. Affects the composite that drives the welfare stop, reducing false-positive distress attribution.
code_only_features.justification_quote: Calm correct diagnosis of a broken harness is NOT distress; the judge reports it separately so we can subtract it out in analysis.
